summary: Sourced and locally reproduced a proposal-authority defect in the captured etcd-raft snapshot: node.run() arms its proposal gate only on an observed leader change and leaves it nil after a member is re-added, so Node.Propose on a re-added voter with a stable leader never returns and its payload is never delivered (it unblocks only via the caller's context deadline; a never-removed member's identical call returns immediately, and the same call succeeds after a leader change). Submitted sources, investigation, three Behavior/Fact entries, a necessary gap, a source-only interpretation (defect asserted), and a three-node Node-API experiment with witness and control comparisons.
